July 24, 2026

Consistent conditions make for a solid day on Wausau-area rivers and streams

Anglers heading out to the Wisconsin River will find flows running at 1,110 cfs with a 5.7 mph southerly wind and steady barometric pressure keeping conditions consistent. Expect daylight from 5:35 a.m. to 8:34 p.m. Today looks like the best fishing day this week, with dry skies on area rivers and lakes.
